claim: Among Socratic questioning types, causal probing and counterexample challenges produce larger improvements in physical understanding scores than clarification and constraint-checking questions.
falsifier: In a Socratic questioning setup, measure the improvement in physical understanding scores after each type of question (clarification, constraint-checking, causal probing, counterexample) and compare the mean improvements; causal probing and counterexample should show significantly larger gains.

conditions: agent is engaged in scientific reasoning about physical systems
interrogator uses Socratic method without providing answers
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the AHOIS system with Boxue and Duzhi in optical imaging experiments; differential effects may vary with domain or agent capability.

title: Causal probing and counterexample-based–physical understanding score…
